question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Behold
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1 i.e. Look.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**Behold**" means to see or observe (someone or something, especially of remarkable or impressive nature).

 
 
• **Example**: When they reached the top of the hill, they beheld a magnificent sunset.
 
 
 
• The correct synonym "**Look**" means to direct one's gaze towards someone or something or in a specified direction. 
 
 
• **Example**: She looked out the window to see if it was raining.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer **is- **Look**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Burden **means a load, especially a heavy one.

 
 
• **Example**: The donkey was carrying a burden too heavy for its size.
 
 
 
• **Fortunate **means having good fortune or luck.
 
 
• **Example**: He was fortunate to have found a job so quickly.
 
 
 
• **Predict **means to say or estimate that (a specified thing) will happen in the future or will be a consequence of something.
 
 
• **Example**: It's difficult to predict the weather accurately.
